name: Hasan Zaigam
summary: AI engineer building LLM-powered production systems: RAG pipelines, AI agents, voice automation, and LLM integration, on a strong backend foundation in Python, FastAPI, and Node.js. Have shipped AI features into live products serving 10,000+ concurrent users, owning the full path from prompt design and orchestration through API and deployment. Anthropic-certified in the Claude API and MCP.

bullets: Design and deploy FastAPI microservices powering AI-driven recommendation, personalization, and LLM-based metadata enrichment for a production OTT platform across Web, Mobile, and Smart TV.
Build event-driven backend workflows using Redis and asynchronous task queues for high-volume transactional processing.
Run cloud delivery on AWS S3 and Cloudflare supporting 10,000+ concurrent users, tuning for low-latency streaming.
Built AI voice-automation workflows for CallerDigital using VAPI, LLM prompt orchestration, and backend APIs, automating internal call-handling processes end to end.
Developed prompt-orchestration pipelines that automated 5+ internal business processes.
Integrated AI services into production applications alongside the engineering team.
Built an internal AI chatbot with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, React, and the Gemini API to support the customer-support workflow.
Improved backend performance across an existing MERN application.
Integrated AI capabilities into the product with a cross-functional team.
